customer: My front brake lever pulled all the way to the handlebar this morning and I nearly went into the back of a car. The bike is three weeks old. What do I do?
reply: Hi Tom, I'm so sorry, that sounds frightening and I'm glad you're okay. This is usually a quick fix. Turn the barrel adjuster where the cable meets the brake lever anticlockwise by two or three turns, then squeeze the lever hard a few times. If the lever still feels soft, loosen the cable clamp bolt on the brake, pull the cable tight and re-tighten. You should be back on the road in ten minutes. Let me know how you get on!

customer: There's a hairline crack in the paint near the seat tube of my frame. I bought the bike 14 months ago. It rides fine. Is that covered?
reply: Hi Riley, thank you for writing in, and I'm sorry to hear about the mark on your frame. I'll explain how this works in full so you know exactly what to expect. All Pedalwick frames carry a two-year warranty from the date of purchase, and since you bought yours 14 months ago you are comfortably within that period. Warranty claims are assessed by our workshop team rather than by the support team, because they need to look closely at what has happened. To start a claim, please reply with two or three clear photos of the area, ideally one from about a metre away to show where on the frame it is, and one or two close up in good daylight. It also helps to include your order number if you have it to hand. Once we have the photos I'll pass everything to the workshop team, and they reply within two working days. Because a mark near the seat tube can sometimes be more than paint, please stop riding the bike until they have looked at it. I've also flagged this to our safety desk today, and they may contact you directly.

customer: The chain on the bike I bought last month squeaks constantly and it's driving me mad. I've ridden it maybe ten times. I want to return it and get my money back.
reply: Hi Dana, as stated clearly on our website when you bought it, ridden bikes can't be returned, so a refund isn't possible. If you think there is a fault with the frame, you can send photos for a warranty claim and the workshop team will reply within two working days.
